scope: Theorem 2.2 (Odd-prime reduction) of the manuscript “Rational homology and Quillen's conjecture” (preprints/Rational-homology-and-Quillens-conjecture-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 310 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 62d7903055f1b292), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that, for every odd prime p, every odd prime power q with p | q + 1, and every simple L = PSUn(q) with n ≥ 5, each elementary p-extension of L inside Aut(L) has the Quillen dimension property. Then (2) holds for every finite group and every odd prime.
